dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (III)
dialogues.text: (A stone tablet eroded by the passage of the long years. The writing is now blurred, the patches that remain now islands of clarity amid a blurry sea...)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (III)
dialogues.text: "But take heed and remember this well! Never be careless... The secret arts of the stone dragon still... a blessing."

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (III)
dialogues.text: "The ash has not been completely removed from Cinder City, and be cautious of the... within..."

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (III)
dialogues.text: "Do not forget... The admonishments and guidance of the Lord of the Night Realm..."
